sloka: तं देशं प्रभया तस्य पुष्पकस्य महाबलः ।कृत्वा वितिमिरं सर्वं समीपं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ७.२१.९ ॥
transliteration: taṁ deśaṁ prabhayā tasya puṣpakasya mahābalaḥ ।kṛtvā vitimiraṁ sarvaṁ samīpaṁ so 'bhyavartata ।। 7.21.9 ॥

translations.english: The mighty one, Ravana, having illuminated the entire region with the radiance of his Pushpaka chariot, then approached that place.
